W_j = ((j+1/2)^d - max(j-1/2,0)^d) h^d/d,

W_j (L_d,h V)_j = A_(j+1/2)(V_(j+1)-V_j)
                   - A_(j-1/2)(V_j-V_(j-1)).

For `j=0`, `W0*2d/h²=A_(1/2)`.
